spans.s:
Pīyūṣa is found in the Rigveda and later in the sense of the first milk of the cow after calving, ‘biestings.’ Usually the term is applied metaphorically to the sap of the soma plant.
Foot notes Cf. ii. 35, 5, where it is applied figuratively to the mothers of agni.
kauśika sūtra, xix. 15. Cf. Av. viii. 9, 24.
Rv. ii. 13, 1; iii. 48, 2; vi. 47, 4; x. 94, 8, etc.
Cf. Geldner, Rigveda, Glossar, 110.
